{"id":"appscript-zvk","title":"AST node classes for all AppScript language constructs","description":"Define AST node classes in AppScript/. Each construct needs its own class: ASClassDefinitionNode (class name, superclass name, protocol names, properties, methods), ASCategoryDefinitionNode (class name, category name, methods), ASPropertyNode (name, modifiers), ASMethodNode (selector, parameter names, body statements, isClassMethod), ASVariableDeclarationNode (name, initializer expression, isWeak, isConstant), ASAssignmentNode, ASMessageSendNode (receiver, selector parts, arguments), ASBlockLiteralNode (parameter names, body statements), ASReturnNode (value expression), ASIdentifierNode, ASStringLiteralNode, ASNumberLiteralNode, ASArrayLiteralNode, ASDictionaryLiteralNode, ASNilLiteralNode, ASBoolLiteralNode. All nodes should inherit from a common ASASTNode base class. All public methods must have /// DocC comments. Create corresponding test files in AppScriptTests/.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z"}

{"id":"appscript-iu4","title":"ASLexer: tokenize AppScript source into a token stream","description":"Implement ASLexer in AppScript/ASLexer.h and AppScript/ASLexer.m. The lexer must tokenize all AppScript language constructs: identifiers, keywords (@class, @end, @category, @property, id, weak, constant, return, self, _cmd), number literals (integer and float), string literals (@\"...\"), array literals (@[...]), dictionary literals (@{...}), boolean literals (YES, NO), the nil literal, block introducers (^), brackets ([ ] { } ( )), the colon separator, class/instance method markers (+ -), operators, and comments (//).  All public methods must have /// DocC documentation comments in the header. Create ASLexerTests.m with XCTest unit tests following the naming convention test_\u003cmethod\u003e_\u003cscenario\u003e_\u003coutcome\u003e. Tests must cover each token type, whitespace handling, comment stripping, and error cases (e.g. unterminated string literals).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z"}

{"id":"appscript-9i8","title":"NSNumber+AppScriptArithmetic: arithmetic category methods","description":"Implement NSNumber+AppScriptArithmetic in AppScript/NSNumber+AppScriptArithmetic.h and AppScript/NSNumber+AppScriptArithmetic.m. Add four methods to NSNumber: - (NSNumber *)numberByAdding:(NSNumber *)other, - (NSNumber *)numberBySubtracting:(NSNumber *)other, - (NSNumber *)numberByMultiplyingBy:(NSNumber *)other, - (NSNumber *)numberByDividingBy:(NSNumber *)other. These must use double arithmetic and return NSNumber instances. All methods need /// DocC comments. Create NSNumber+AppScriptArithmeticTests.m with unit tests for each operation including edge cases (zero, negative numbers, large values).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-gqd","title":"NSNumber+AppScriptControlFlow and NSObject+AppScriptControlFlow categories","description":"Implement control flow categories. NSNumber+AppScriptControlFlow in AppScript/NSNumber+AppScriptControlFlow.h/.m: add - (id)ifTrue:(id (^)(void))trueBlock ifFalse:(id (^)(void))falseBlock — executes trueBlock if the receiver is non-zero and non-nil, falseBlock otherwise; returns the result of whichever block executed, or nil if the block has no return value. NSObject+AppScriptControlFlow in AppScript/NSObject+AppScriptControlFlow.h/.m: add - (id)do:(id (^)(void))aBlock while:(id (^)(void))testBlock (runs aBlock while testBlock returns non-nil/non-NO, may not run aBlock at all) and - (id)do:(id (^)(void))aBlock until:(id (^)(void))testBlock (runs aBlock until testBlock returns nil or NO, guaranteed to run at least once). All methods need /// DocC comments. Create corresponding test files.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-nvx","title":"ASBoxer: automatic boxing and unboxing of ObjC primitive types","description":"Implement ASBoxer in AppScript/ASBoxer.h and AppScript/ASBoxer.m. Boxing: convert C primitives (int, NSInteger, CGFloat, double, float, BOOL, etc.) and C strings to appropriate NSNumber/NSString/NSValue instances. Unboxing: inspect a method's actual ObjC type encoding (via NSMethodSignature) and convert NSObject arguments to the required C type by sending the appropriate NSValue/NSNumber accessor (e.g. integerValue, doubleValue, boolValue). Handle return value boxing: wrap primitive return values into NSNumber or NSString. Handle void return. Handle struct types via NSValue. All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create ASBoxerTests.m with unit tests for each supported type conversion in both directions.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z"}

{"id":"appscript-1dv","title":"ASParser: parse AppScript token stream into an AST","description":"Implement ASParser in AppScript/ASParser.h and AppScript/ASParser.m. The parser consumes the token stream produced by ASLexer and produces an array of top-level AST nodes (class and category definitions). Parse all language constructs per ARCHITECTURE.md: @class declarations with superclass and optional protocol list, @category declarations, @property declarations with optional modifiers, instance and class method definitions with infix selector syntax, variable declarations (id, weak id, constant id), message sends (including multi-keyword selectors), block literals (^{ } and ^(args) { }), return statements, string/number/array/dictionary/nil/bool/selector literals. The parser must produce actionable error messages with line numbers for syntax errors. All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create ASParserTests.m with comprehensive unit tests.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z"}

{"id":"appscript-s7i","title":"DocC catalog and articles for the AppScript framework","description":"Create the DocC documentation catalog at AppScript/Documentation.docc/. The top-level AppScript.md catalog file must list all public types and link to all articles. Required articles: (1) LoadingAndRunningAppScriptFiles.md — the load-\u003eparse-\u003einstall-\u003einvoke pipeline; (2) DefiningClassesAndCategories.md — how AppScript class and category definitions map to ObjC runtime registration; (3) ControlFlowAndArithmetic.md — the NSNumber/NSObject control flow and arithmetic API. Each article must use \u003cdoc:SymbolName\u003e link syntax to reference every method and type it describes. This task may be worked on in parallel with implementation tasks but should be reviewed alongside each feature task.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-ykm","title":"ASInterpreter: evaluate AppScript AST nodes","description":"Implement ASInterpreter in AppScript/ASInterpreter.h and AppScript/ASInterpreter.m. The interpreter must: maintain a variable scope stack (push/push scope on method/block entry, pop on exit), resolve identifiers against the scope stack, evaluate all expression node types (message sends, block literals, literals), implement variable declaration with weak/constant semantics, implement assignment with constant-reassignment error detection, evaluate multi-keyword message sends, implement return value semantics for methods and blocks, make self and _cmd implicitly available in method bodies, implement block capture semantics (captured variables from enclosing AppScript scope are automatically __block-equivalent for non-constant variables), ensure self inside a block refers to the enclosing method's receiver. The interpreter must be thread-safe: multiple threads may invoke it simultaneously. Document the owning dispatch queue for all mutable state. All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create ASInterpreterTests.m.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:08Z"}

{"id":"appscript-547","title":"ObjC runtime integration: register AppScript classes and install method IMPs","description":"Implement ASRuntimeInstaller in AppScript/ASRuntimeInstaller.h and AppScript/ASRuntimeInstaller.m. Given a parsed set of class/category definitions: register new class pairs with objc_allocateClassPair / objc_registerClassPair using the declared superclass. For each method in the class, create a trampoline IMP that (a) boxes incoming C parameters to id using ASBoxer, (b) invokes ASInterpreter with the method's AST fragment, (c) unboxes the return value using ASBoxer. Use class_addMethod for new methods and method_setImplementation for overrides. Synthesize KVC-compliant getter (and setter unless readonly) for each @property not marked dynamic, unless the developer provides a custom implementation. For @category definitions, add/replace methods on the existing class. On interpreter error, output the AppScript file path and line number to stderr then call abort(). All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create ASRuntimeInstallerTests.m.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-88g","title":"NSBundle+AppScriptLoading: loadAppScriptsInBundle: category","description":"Implement NSBundle+AppScriptLoading in AppScript/NSBundle+AppScriptLoading.h and AppScript/NSBundle+AppScriptLoading.m. The category method - (BOOL)loadAppScriptsInBundle:(NSError **)error must: (1) track which bundles have been loaded and return NO with an error if called twice on the same bundle, (2) search for *.as files in the bundle using NSBundle's resource methods, (3) for each file, read the source, run ASLexer then ASParser, abort with error on parse failure, (4) pass the resulting AST to ASRuntimeInstaller to register classes and install methods. The method must be thread-safe. All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create NSBundle+AppScriptLoadingTests.m. Also write a DocC article AppScript/Documentation.docc/LoadingAndRunningAppScriptFiles.md covering the full load-\u003eparse-\u003einstall-\u003einvoke pipeline, linked from the framework catalog.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-gf7","title":"AppScriptHarness: integration test harness application","description":"Implement the AppScriptHarness macOS application as specified in CODING_STANDARDS.md. The harness must: (1) call loadAppScriptsInBundle: on a bundle containing *.as test scripts, (2) for each script, find the class whose name ends in Test, instantiate it, and call -runTests, (3) call -description on the returned object and compare to the content of the paired *.expected file, (4) print a pass/fail summary to stdout, (5) exit with code 0 if all pass or 1 if any fail. The harness must run headlessly for CI. Add at least one end-to-end harness test script (e.g. ArithmeticTest.as with ArithmeticTest.expected) that exercises the full load-\u003eparse-\u003einterpret-\u003eresult pipeline. All source files need the AGPL license header.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"grahamlee@acm.org","created_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z","created_by":"Graham Lee","updated_at":"2026-03-09T17:16:09Z"}

{"id":"appscript-rzb","title":"Fix ASBoxer: handle '#' (Class) type encoding","description":"ASBoxer.m's ASBoxBytes function has no case for '#' (the ObjC type encoding for Class).
